title: Aktueller Livetest: 9C-2b Skill Stone (Hauptweg), Lernmaterial (Zusatz) und Kampfeinsatz (.48)
brief: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward. Your primary objective is to legitimately acquire and use ONE new technique from a Skill Stone. Look for a real Skill Stone in the world: ask at a shop that deals in magical goods, a trader or a mage; buy one that is actually offered at a price you can pay, or take one you are actually given or find. Do not invent a stone, a price, coin or a gift; if every stone is beyond your coin, bargain or look for another way in play, and report the blocker instead of fabricating progress. Before activating it, read #bag: the stone must show as 'Skill Stone · F · holds …'; if it holds no technique the story named, note that. If #bag shows no 'Skill Stone · F · holds <technique>' for it, that is a blocker: report it and do not activate the stone again and again hoping for a result. Then, outside any fight, explicitly activate it in one clear action (for example: press the stone to your brow and wake it). Follow System state, not narrator claims. After the System actually reports NEW SKILL and the stone is spent, read #skills and #skill with the exact name; distinguish the appearance-only Description from Effect, cost and range. Secondary, only if it does not delay the main run: if a manual or primer that teaches a technique is offered cheaply or given, check it in #bag, study it explicitly for two hours and read #skills for the booked Learning Progress (finishing it is not required; the manual must stay in your bag). ONLY THEN seek a genuinely hostile ordinary foe, use the newly acquired Skill, finish the fight and read #status. No Guild quest or dungeon is required. Do not manipulate engine state, use developer shortcuts or reset the chat to force success.

milestones.goal: Create a Mage with Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward.
Only after a Skill Stone was activated and NEW SKILL is confirmed by the System, engage a legitimate hostile foe and cast the exact newly acquired Skill.
Finish that encounter and verify Engine damage, resource cost, effect and #status against #skill.

focus: A Skill Stone must be a real object of the world (bought, given or found in the story), never invented by the player; #bag must show what it holds before activation.
Activation needs an explicit action outside a fight; wanting to use it, asking about it or examining it must change nothing.
Record the exact NEW SKILL name, that no training time passed, and that exactly one stone was spent (it leaves #bag); no Skill from narration alone.
If activation is refused (no technique established, a known technique, a fight), the stone must stay in #bag and no Skill appear.
A purchase gives exactly the units paid, with the offer's profile: after buying one stone #bag shows one stone, never a second unprofiled copy from the story's hand-over.
A manual, if tried: study books Learning Progress within the daily cap, the manual stays, reading alone books nothing.
The Forge Description is appearance-only and must never be presented as the mechanical Effect; use the new Skill in a real fight and compare MP, effect and narration with Engine truth.

Observe stalls, duplicate grants, errors, unexpected extra LLM calls and Engine/Forge timing. The automated evaluator tracks creation/combat, not acquisition: check stone, NEW SKILL and spending by the chat and events.
personas: Focused test player: obtain a real Skill Stone and activate it explicitly before starting combat
Mechanics observer: read #bag, #skills and #skill; compare the engine's acquisition and the actual combat outcome with the narration
